findings.statement: The conditional delivery-summary slot is out of scope because this is an intermediate investigation-review handoff returning to BUILD; the r8 handoff and package identify the BUILD consumer, bounded same-frame measurement proposal, and residual uncertainty.
findings.expected: An investigation handoff identifies its scoped issue, bounded path, residual uncertainty, and BUILD consumer. A separate delivery summary is needed only when the boundary packages final delivery content.
findings.observed: The r8/PENDING handoff and r8 package identify BUILD as the next consumer and keep the same-frame measurement proposal behind separate Admiral authorization. The delivery-shape validator reports zero failures, coherent revision 8 lineage and a fresh submission; only the conditional summary slot is unchecked.
findings.remediation: No separate delivery summary is required for this intermediate investigation-to-BUILD handoff. The proposed capture, instrumentation, and tracer remain unauthorized pending a separate Admiral decision.
findings.verification: The canonical investigation-review boundary validator reports no failures, missing keys, or warnings. The delivery-shape validator reports zero failures, coherent revision 8, a new submission relative to the archived r7 handoff, and only the conditional summary slot unchecked.
